title: iPhone XR maker Pegatron says labor shortages fixed, no orders switching to Foxconn
text: iPhone XR maker Pegatron says labor shortages fixed, no orders switching to Foxconn Tuesday, 6 November 2018 ( 1 hour ago ) Pegatron was able to solve workforce shortages in time for the October launch of the iPhone XR, and despite rumors is holding onto its share of production for the device, a report indicated this week. ▶ iPhone XR Production Boost Cancelled 00:42 Reuters reports that Apple Inc has told its smartphone assemblers Foxconn and Pegatron to halt plans for additional production lines dedicated to the iPhone XR. The phones hit shelves in October. Citing supply chain sources, the report said, Apple had also asked smaller iPhone assembler Wistron to...
